name: Blesmolfolk Consort
body:
Second only to the Queen—and fellow consorts—in power, the consort occupies a truly privileged position in blesmolfolk society. Consorts bear all of their Queen’s power and none of the responsibility, and they let the “lesser castes” know it.

Physical Description: Consorts are almost identical to warriors, standing around 5’6”. They generally go naked, however, or wearing only loincloths—clothing is not a blesmolfolk custom, and is seen as a mark of lower status. Unlike most blesmolfolk, consorts have beady red eyes. Their plump bodies are weak and sluggish, and blesmolfolk consorts speak with slow drawls. Thanks to their slow metabolism, consorts, like most blesmolfolk, can live as long as 2,000 years. The vast majority of consorts are male.

Society: Consorts love to abuse their power, ordering warriors and workers to carve immense statues and monuments to their greatness—and the greatness of their Queen, of course. They are fiercely loyal to the breeding Queen, mainly because the Queen is the source of their social rank, and without them, they’re no better than dirty warriors. They tend to occupy managerial positions, such as administrators or magistrates, where they don’t have to do much other than boss lessers around. Frustratingly, consorts are actually very fast learners in spite of their laziness, and can master even esoteric skills in half the time it takes anyone else.

Relations: Consorts see association with outsiders as a “lower-caste duty,” and avoid it on principle. They treat smaller races like servants, and taller races, like half-orcs and elves, like worthy butlers. Dwarves see them as foppish and vain. Some elves, sharing the consorts’ hedonistic mindsets, find them to be decent friends for a one-night outing, but rather unsuited for long-term friendships.

Alignment and Religion: Consorts are self-interested and chafe under restrictions, believing that rules are made to suit them. Most blesmolfolk consorts are chaotic neutral. Consorts are positively religious about their Queen, and rarely have time for other gods.

Adventurers: Some blesmolfolk hives are very small. As such, it is not uncommon for a blesmolfolk consort to simply find himself without a hive after a run-in with some monsters. Others leave after falling out of favor with their Queen. Consorts like to become clerics or sorcerers, favoring adventuring jobs with minimal risk and work.

Core Traits (13 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: Like most blesmolfolk, consorts are hardy. They are also very good at convincing others to do as they say, having perfected the art of “slow fast-talking.” They gain +2 Charisma and +2 Constitution. 2 RP
Size: Blesmolfolk consorts are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Blesmolfolk consorts have a base speed of 20 feet. They also have a burrow speed of 20 feet. 2 RP
Languages: Blesmolfolk consorts begin play speaking only Blesmol. Consorts with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Common, Elven, Dwarven, Draconic, and Undercommon.
Other Traits
Pain Immunity: Blesmolfolk consorts do not feel pain and are immune to all pain-based effects. They cannot be knocked unconscious from nonlethal damage, though they can still begin to take lethal damage if their nonlethal damage is equal to their total maximum hit points. 3 RP
Focused Study: Consorts are both insufferably lazy and insufferably talented. At 1st, 8th, and 16th level, blesmolfolk consorts gain Skill Focus in a skill of their choice as a bonus feat. 4 RP
Silver Tongued: Blesmolfolk consorts gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks, and these skills are always class skills for them. In addition, when they use Diplomacy to shift a creature’s attitude, they can do so up to three steps up rather than just two. 3 RP
Toughness: Blesmolfolk consorts gain Toughness as a bonus feat. 2 RP
Weapon Familiarity: Blesmolfolk consorts are proficient with blesmol staves, and treat blesmol flails as martial weapons. 1 RP
Small Eyes: Blesmolfolk consorts can only see clearly out to 30 feet. Beyond that, all subjects gain concealment. Blesmolfolk take a –4 penalty on sight-based Perception checks. –5 RP
Hold Breath: Blesmolfolk consorts can hold their breath for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating. 1 RP
Alternate Racial Traits

The following racial traits may be selected instead of existing consort traits.

Assassin: Some consorts are extremely untrustworthy and self-interested—enough that they have learned to kill to achieve their ends. Blesmolfolk consorts gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) and Stealth checks. These skills are always considered a class skills. This trait replaces focused study.
Liar: Some consorts are more focused on blatant deception than subtle misdirection, and skillfully mislead those around them. These consorts gain a +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks to convince others that what they are saying is true when they tell a lie. Once per day, they may roll twice when making a Bluff check and take the better roll. This trait replaces silver tongued.
Fanatic: Not all consorts are untrustworthy self-interested slackers. Some are devoutly loyal to their queen, and gain a +2 racial bonus on Will saving throws. This trait replaces skilled.
Observant: Some consorts understand that careful observation is critical to success in court life. Blesmolfolk consorts gain a +1 racial bonus to Sense Motive, and this is always considered a class skill. Consorts who choose this trait do not gain weapon familiarity.
